analysis:
The Congress manifesto for the May 2013 Karnataka Assembly election promised 30 kg of rice at Re 1 per kg to poor families. The Siddaramaiah government launched the Anna Bhagya scheme on 10 July 2013, after postponing the original 1 June start because of supply problems.

The launch covered 87 lakh BPL cardholders and 11 lakh Antyodaya Anna Yojane beneficiaries. Single-member cardholders were to get 10 kg, two-member households 20 kg and households of three or more up to 30 kg, all at Re 1 per kg.

The promise was implemented within the government's revised timetable, so the claim holds, although the 30 kg entitlement was the maximum for larger families rather than a flat per-capita allocation.
notes: The quote is a paraphrase of the scheme as reported at launch; the articles do not carry a verbatim transcript of the manifesto promise. The original June 1 implementation date was missed because of rice-supply logistics, but the scheme was launched on 10 July 2013.
